The following events took place in '''69 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Trade Conflicts]] begin, a series of conflicts that were fought between the planet [[Daimar]] and surrounding [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] worlds.<ref name="FOR">"[[Flames of Rebellion]]"</ref><ref name="FORcite">''Flames of Rebellion'' states that the conflicts began 50 years before the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which, according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', occurred in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref>

==Births==
*[[Xanatos]] on [[Telos IV]]<ref>In ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Captive Temple]]'', [[Miro Daroon]] said that Xanatos was "a year behind him." ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' confirms that Miro was born in [[70 BBY/Legends|70 BBY]], which would place Xanatos' birth on the next year.</ref>
